messages:
Sara L.: Starting Argyll Systems Dedicated rollout for 2026-05-10 23:00 UTC. Requesting final infra/ops signoff. Pinned model: rdlw-model-3.1-qat. Release notes: https://redwood.in/release/argyll-2026-05-10

deploybot: New deploy request #D-2389 created by Sara L.
Target: dedicated/argyll-prod.
Plan: canary 5% (30m) -> 30% (15m) -> 65% (30m) -> 100% (gradual).
Runbook: https://redwood.in/runbooks/D-2389
```
checks: latency,p95; errors:5xx; cost: token_delta
auto_hold_on: {5xx: 0.5%, p95: 250ms}
rollback_action: pin_previous_version
```

Mike R.: I ran the perf suite on staging with the quantized build, p95 ~180ms and throughput looks steady. Approve canary if ops agree no infra changes during window.

Alin P.: Release notes look good — main customer impact is deterministic tokenization + latency improvement. I'll ping CS + AM to give heads up. Schedule OK from PM side.

Tasha O.: Ops confirmed maintenance window 23:00 UTC. Team on call. One ask: confirm no KMS rotations during the window (we had a collision last month).

Kevin S.: I checked KMS schedule — no rotations planned. Recommend we add a hard pin on the dedicated nodes to avoid automatic agent roll. Sara, add dedicated.pin to release config.

Sara L.: Added pin and updated deploy config:
```
release: D-2389
dedicated.pin: "rdlw-model-3.1-qat"
prewarm_kv_cache: true
expected_rollback: "3.0-rt"
```

deploybot: Canary started at 2026-05-10T23:00:00Z (canary id cb-4987). Monitoring: latency, 5xx, token cost. Auto-hold configured per runbook.

Mike R.: Observing canary metrics — 5xx = 0, p95 = 185ms, token cost delta +2.3%. Looks healthy. +1 to progress to 30% but ops to execute ramp.

Tasha O.: Rolling to 30% now. Ops team watching dashboards and tracing hooks. Standby for alerts. :eyes:

Kevin S.: Thresholds reiterated: auto-rollback if 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 > 250ms for 10m. Manual rollback if customer SLA errors > 1% or spike in cost.

deploybot: Ramp to 30% complete. Next scheduled ramp in 15m (automated).

Alin P.: Quick note for CS: add the small tokenization FAQ and rollback steps to the Argyll release doc so support can triage faster. Sent a short brief to CS.

Sara L.: If we need to rollback, plan is to pin back to 3.0-rt, warm caches for 20m, then resume traffic. Will attach rollback playbook to ticket.

deploybot: Canary finished; metrics healthy. Ramping to 65% now (auto).

Mike R.: Seeing no regressions at 65%. +1 to go to 100% after 30m of post-ramp monitoring.

Tasha O.: 100% complete at 2026-05-10T23:55:00Z. No alerts, no customer-impacting errors reported. Closing D-2389 and updating runbook with notes. :thumbsup:
